source.custody: exact upstream revision cloned in hosted workflow

coordinates.Q: public libdeflate compressor/decompressor capability: allocator and bounded public APIs are available, measured before inspecting action output
coordinates.R: x86 dispatch feature mask: baseline has at least one advanced vector/accelerated feature; ROUTE_DROP disables the declared advanced feature set via upstream LIBDEFLATE_DISABLE_CPU_FEATURES while retaining SSE2/scalar fallback
coordinates.G: zlib stream-format gate: CMF/FLG header validity (CM=8 and header checksum divisible by 31), directly measured before decompression
coordinates.Y: public zlib compression/decompression action returns the original fixed payload byte-for-byte against the same payload oracle

interventions.Q_DROP: not claimed for this route-transport candidate; capability falsifier remains prospective and must not be simulated by malformed input
interventions.G_DROP: not claimed for this route-transport candidate; stream-format gate is measured and held fixed
interventions.MATCHED_REPAIRED_STATE: reserved for a later candidate; no post-hoc state matching

expected_transition.classification: X1_CROSS_MECHANISM_FALLBACK_PRESERVING_ROUTE_DROP if direct measurements satisfy the transition

disqualifiers: advanced route remains enabled after the declared feature disable list
public action fails or differs from the common payload oracle
Q inferred from Y rather than API capability
G inferred from route or output
unknown feature-control behavior, missing exact source, or performance-only evidence
claim_ceiling: cross-mechanism transport/calibration of X1 route/action separation only; no same-state action split, no scalar exhaustiveness upgrade, no LAW-R2
